title: Microsoft Learn
description: Microsoft Learn provides free, interactive training for Microsoft technologies and platforms. Features hands-on learning paths, modules, and certifications. Perfect for developers working with Azure, .NET, and Microsoft cloud technologies.

title: Google Career Certificates
description: Google Career Certificates provide professional training in high-demand fields. Features hands-on projects, expert instructors, and job-ready skills. Programs include Data Analytics, IT Support, UX Design, and more with potential for career advancement.

title: Stanford Online
description: Stanford Online offers professional education courses and degrees from Stanford University. Features expert instructors, flexible learning options, and recognized credentials. Access Stanford's renowned faculty and cutting-edge research.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: MIT OpenCourseWare provides free course materials from MIT's undergraduate and graduate level courses. Features comprehensive materials including lecture notes, assignments, and exams. Access world-class education from one of the top universities.

title: CS50's Web Programming
description: CS50's Web Programming course from Harvard University. Features comprehensive coverage of web technologies, practical projects, and problem sets. Taught by David Malan, this course provides a solid foundation in modern web development.

title: The Odin Project
description: The Odin Project is a comprehensive open-source curriculum for learning web development. Features structured learning paths, project-based learning, and community support. Covers everything from basics to advanced topics with practical projects.

title: Fullstack Open
description: Fullstack Open is a comprehensive course on modern web development. Features MERN stack development, GraphQL, TypeScript, and React Native. Includes building real applications and is highly regarded in the developer community.

title: Hugging Face Learn
description: Hugging Face Learn offers comprehensive courses on natural language processing and machine learning. Features interactive notebooks, practical examples, and hands-on experience with state-of-the-art models. Perfect for learning modern NLP techniques.

title: fast.ai
description: fast.ai provides practical deep learning courses that make AI accessible to everyone. Features cutting-edge research, practical coding lessons, and a supportive community. Known for making complex AI concepts simple and approachable.

title: DeepLearning.AI
description: DeepLearning.AI offers specialized courses and certifications in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Founded by Andrew Ng, features practical, hands-on learning with real-world applications. Perfect for developers looking to specialize in AI and ML technologies.

title: Coursera
description: Coursera partners with top universities and companies to offer online courses, specializations, and degrees. Features include video lectures, peer-reviewed assignments, certificates, and full degree programs. Courses from Stanford, Yale, Google, IBM, and more. Free audit option available, paid certificates, and subscription plans. Covers technology, business, data science, arts, and more. Perfect for professional development and academic learning.

title: Khan Academy
description: Khan Academy is a free online learning platform offering courses and tutorials in various subjects, with a focus on education and career development.

title: Codecademy
description: Codecademy is an interactive online learning platform for coding and programming. Features hands-on coding exercises, real-time feedback, projects, and career paths. Covers web development, data science, computer science, and more. Free tier with basic courses, Pro subscription for advanced content and certificates. Great for beginners with its interactive approach. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and many other languages.
